source: The route registrations and form parsing in Gotenberg's pkg/modules (chromium/routes.go, libreoffice/routes.go, pdf/routes.go, api/api.go); defaults from DefaultOptions. npm run check:api compares the routes, fields and extensions with a Gotenberg checkout.

routes.summary: Prints a web page to PDF.
Prints an HTML file, with the assets beside it, to PDF.
Prints Markdown files, laid out by an HTML template, to PDF.
Captures a web page as an image.
Captures an HTML file as an image.
Captures Markdown files, laid out by an HTML template, as an image.
Converts office documents, such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, to PDF.
Runs a list of stages on PDFs.
Runs one stage, its options as form fields: `/forms/pdf/merge`, `/forms/pdf/rotate`, and so on.
Reads the page count, the PDF version, and whether a PDF is encrypted, tagged, linearized or holds form fields.
Reads the metadata: title, author, dates.
Checks PDFs against PDF/A, PDF/UA or Factur-X, and lists the violations.
Answers a short note: Gotenberg has no UI.
Reports whether Gotenberg and its engines are up.
Answers the modules, engine versions and flags, once `--api-enable-debug-route` is on.

chromium.name: waitDelay
chromium.description: Waits this long once the page loads, before printing: `2s`, `500ms`.

chromium.name: waitForSelector
chromium.description: Waits until an element matching this CSS selector is visible, such as `#chart.ready`.

chromium.name: waitForExpression
chromium.description: Waits until this JavaScript expression returns true, such as `window.ready === true`.

chromium.name: skipNetworkIdleEvent
chromium.description: Prints without waiting for the network to go idle. `false` waits, for pages that fetch content after they load.

chromium.name: skipNetworkAlmostIdleEvent
chromium.description: Prints without waiting for the network to go almost idle. `false` waits.

chromium.name: failOnHttpStatusCodes
chromium.description: Answers 409 when the page itself answers one of these statuses. `499` stands for 400 to 499, `599` for 500 to 599, and so on for each hundred.

chromium.name: failOnResourceHttpStatusCodes
chromium.description: Answers 409 when a resource the page loads, such as an image or a script, answers one of these statuses. Ranges work as for `failOnHttpStatusCodes`.

chromium.name: ignoreResourceHttpStatusDomains
chromium.description: Domains, subdomains included, that `failOnResourceHttpStatusCodes` leaves out: `["sentry-cdn.com"]`.

chromium.name: failOnResourceLoadingFailed
chromium.description: Answers 409 when a resource fails to load.

chromium.name: failOnConsoleExceptions
chromium.description: Answers 409 when the page throws a JavaScript exception.

chromium.name: failOnConsoleMessageTypes
chromium.description: Answers 409 when the page writes one of these console types: `log`, `debug`, `info`, `warning`, `error` or `assert`.

chromium.name: cookies
chromium.description: Cookies to set before loading: items with a `name`, a `value` and a `domain`, and optionally a `path`, `secure`, `httpOnly` and `sameSite` (`Strict`, `Lax` or `None`).

chromium.name: extraHttpHeaders
chromium.description: Headers Chromium sends with the requests the page makes: `{"X-Token": "abc"}`. End a value with `;scope=<regex>` to send it only to the URLs the regex matches. At most 64 headers.

chromium.name: emulatedMediaType
chromium.description: The CSS media type the page sees: `screen` or `print`.

chromium.name: emulatedMediaFeatures
chromium.description: CSS media features the page sees: `[{"name": "prefers-color-scheme", "value": "dark"}]`.

chromium.name: omitBackground
chromium.description: Drops the default white background, for a transparent PDF or image. A PDF needs `printBackground` too.

chromium-pdf.name: paperSize
chromium-pdf.description: `A3`, `A4`, `A5`, `B4`, `B5`, `Letter`, `Legal` or `Tabloid`, in any case. Sets the width and the height.

chromium-pdf.name: paperWidth
chromium-pdf.description: Overrides the width `paperSize` sets. A length is a number in inches, or a number with a unit: `210mm`, `21cm`, `595pt`, `794px`, `50pc`.

chromium-pdf.name: marginTop
chromium-pdf.description: The top margin. The header prints in it.

chromium-pdf.name: marginBottom
chromium-pdf.description: The bottom margin. The footer prints in it.

chromium-pdf.name: preferCssPageSize
chromium-pdf.description: Uses the size the page's CSS `@page` rule sets, over the paper size.

chromium-pdf.name: singlePage
chromium-pdf.description: Prints the whole page on one page, as tall as the content.

chromium-pdf.name: nativePages
chromium-pdf.description: Pages to print, in Chromium's syntax: `1-5, 8, 11-13`. A page past the end answers 400. The `select` stage picks pages after printing, and takes `odd`, `even` and `last` too.

chromium-pdf.name: header.html
chromium-pdf.description: Upload it under `files`: Chromium prints it at the top of each page. Elements with the class `date`, `title`, `url`, `pageNumber` or `totalPages` receive that value. It shares one document with the footer, so give each its own class names.

chromium-pdf.name: footer.html
chromium-pdf.description: The same, at the bottom of each page.

chromium-pdf.name: nativeBookmarks
chromium-pdf.description: Builds bookmarks from the headings. Implies `nativeTaggedPdf`.

chromium-pdf.name: nativeTaggedPdf
chromium-pdf.description: Writes a tagged PDF, whose structure screen readers follow.

chromium-screenshot.name: quality
chromium-screenshot.description: The JPEG quality, from 1 to 100. Other formats ignore it.

chromium-screenshot.name: width
chromium-screenshot.description: The viewport width, in CSS pixels.

chromium-screenshot.name: height
chromium-screenshot.description: The viewport height, in CSS pixels.

chromium-screenshot.name: clip
chromium-screenshot.description: Captures the viewport only. Without it, the image is as tall as the page.

chromium-screenshot.name: selector
chromium-screenshot.description: Captures the first element matching this CSS selector, over `clip`. No visible match answers 400.

chromium-screenshot.name: deviceScaleFactor
chromium-screenshot.description: Image pixels per CSS pixel: `2` doubles the resolution.

chromium-screenshot.name: optimizeForSpeed
chromium-screenshot.description: Encodes faster, for a larger file.

libreoffice.name: password
libreoffice.description: Opens a password-protected document.

libreoffice.name: paperSize
libreoffice.description: `A3`, `A4`, `A5`, `B4`, `B5`, `Letter`, `Legal` or `Tabloid`, in any case, for every page. Without it, each document keeps its own page size.

libreoffice.name: paperWidth
libreoffice.description: Overrides the width `paperSize` sets. Without `paperSize`, set `paperHeight` too. A length is a number in inches, or a number with a unit: `210mm`, `21cm`, `595pt`, `794px`, `50pc`.

libreoffice.name: paperHeight
libreoffice.description: Overrides the height `paperSize` sets. Without `paperSize`, set `paperWidth` too.

libreoffice.name: landscape
libreoffice.description: Turns the pages sideways.

libreoffice.name: nativePages
libreoffice.description: Pages to export, in LibreOffice's syntax: `1-4`, `2`, `1,3,5-7`. The `select` stage picks pages after the conversion, and takes `odd`, `even` and `last` too.

libreoffice.name: singlePage
libreoffice.description: Puts each sheet of a spreadsheet on one page, hidden sheets included, regardless of its paper size and print ranges.

libreoffice.name: skipEmptyPages
libreoffice.description: Drops the blank pages a text document inserts on its own.

libreoffice.name: updateIndexes
libreoffice.description: Updates the tables of contents and the other indexes before the export.

libreoffice.name: exportFormFields
libreoffice.description: Exports form fields as fields a reader can fill. `false` prints their values only.

libreoffice.name: allowDuplicateFieldNames
libreoffice.description: Lets several form fields share a name.

libreoffice.name: nativeBookmarks
libreoffice.description: Exports the document's bookmarks, built from its headings.

libreoffice.name: exportBookmarksToPdfDestination
libreoffice.description: Also exports the bookmarks as named destinations, which links can target.

libreoffice.name: exportPlaceholders
libreoffice.description: Shows the placeholder fields' markings. The exported placeholders do nothing.

libreoffice.name: exportNotes
libreoffice.description: Exports comments as PDF annotations.

libreoffice.name: exportNotesInMargin
libreoffice.description: Prints comments in the page margin.

libreoffice.name: exportNotesPages
libreoffice.description: Adds a presentation's notes pages.

libreoffice.name: exportOnlyNotesPages
libreoffice.description: Exports the notes pages only, with `exportNotesPages`.

libreoffice.name: exportHiddenSlides
libreoffice.description: Includes the slides hidden from the slide show.

libreoffice.name: useTransitionEffects
libreoffice.description: Exports a presentation's slide transitions.

libreoffice.name: convertOooTargetToPdfTarget
libreoffice.description: Points links to `.odt`, `.ods`, `.odp` and `.odg` files at `.pdf` files of the same name.

libreoffice.name: exportLinksRelativeFsys
libreoffice.description: Exports `file://` links relative to the document.

libreoffice.name: addOriginalDocumentAsStream
libreoffice.description: Embeds the original document in the PDF, for archiving.

libreoffice.name: nativeQuality
libreoffice.description: The JPEG quality of the images, from 1 to 100.

libreoffice.name: nativeLosslessImageCompression
libreoffice.description: Compresses images losslessly, instead of as JPEG.

libreoffice.name: nativeReduceImageResolution
libreoffice.description: Downsamples images to `nativeMaxImageResolution`.

libreoffice.name: nativeMaxImageResolution
libreoffice.description: The resolution `nativeReduceImageResolution` downsamples to, in DPI: `75`, `150`, `300`, `600` or `1200`.

libreoffice.name: nativeWatermarkText
libreoffice.description: Draws this text on every page. Set it or `nativeTiledWatermarkText`, not both.

libreoffice.name: nativeWatermarkColor
libreoffice.description: The text color, as `#rrggbb`.

libreoffice.name: nativeWatermarkFontSize
libreoffice.description: The font size, in points. Without it, the text spans the page.

libreoffice.name: nativeWatermarkRotation
libreoffice.description: The angle, in degrees, counter-clockwise. Without it, the text runs down a portrait page and across a landscape one.

libreoffice.name: nativeWatermarkFont
libreoffice.description: The font name.

libreoffice.name: nativeTiledWatermarkText
libreoffice.description: Repeats this text across every page, in a grid. Set it or `nativeWatermarkText`, not both: the size, color, font and rotation fields apply to `nativeWatermarkText` only.

libreoffice.name: nativePdfa
libreoffice.description: Exports PDF/A: `PDF/A-1b`, `PDF/A-2b`, `PDF/A-3b` or `PDF/A-4`. The `remediate` stage reaches the other PDF/A levels.

libreoffice.name: nativePdfua
libreoffice.description: Exports PDF/UA: `PDF/UA-1`.

libreoffice.name: nativeTaggedPdf
libreoffice.description: Writes a tagged PDF, whose structure screen readers follow, without declaring PDF/UA.

libreoffice.name: initialView
libreoffice.description: The side panel a viewer opens: `default`, `outline` or `thumbnails`.

libreoffice.name: initialPage
libreoffice.description: The page a viewer opens at.

libreoffice.name: magnification
libreoffice.description: How a viewer fits the page: `default`, `fitWindow`, `fitWidth`, `fitVisible` or `zoom`.

libreoffice.name: zoom
libreoffice.description: The zoom, in percent, with `magnification` set to `zoom`.

libreoffice.name: pageLayout
libreoffice.description: How a viewer lays the pages out: `default`, `singlePage`, `oneColumn` or `twoColumnRight`, two columns with the first page on the right. LibreOffice can't put it on the left.

libreoffice.name: openBookmarkLevels
libreoffice.description: How many bookmark levels a viewer expands, from 1 to 10. `-1` expands them all.

libreoffice.name: resizeWindowToInitialPage
libreoffice.description: Sizes the viewer's window to the first page shown.

libreoffice.name: centerWindow
libreoffice.description: Centers the viewer's window on the screen.

libreoffice.name: openInFullScreenMode
libreoffice.description: Opens the viewer full screen.

libreoffice.name: displayPDFDocumentTitle
libreoffice.description: Shows the document title, not the file name, in the viewer's title bar.

libreoffice.name: hideViewerMenubar
libreoffice.description: Hides the viewer's menu bar.

libreoffice.name: hideViewerToolbar
libreoffice.description: Hides the viewer's toolbar.

libreoffice.name: hideViewerWindowControls
libreoffice.description: Hides the viewer's window controls.
